provenance: Synthetic DiagramML controls independently regenerated and saved by the native reference application. Native layout rejection tests numeric-mode validity both with and without overflow. Native active versus inactive factor adjustments distinguish own-scope reference formulas from inherited values. These tests resolve the declared rule limit in the original scope; they do not claim to reproduce the fitted value chosen by the native reference application. Geometry/font search outcomes remain a separate stage.
